# Phalanx Duel

> Zero-RNG, deterministic 2-player tactical card game playable in the browser, via Go CLI, over MCP for AI agents, or face-to-face with any standard 52-card deck. Open source under AGPL-3.0.

## Play & Interactive Tools
- [Play Live in Browser (No Signup Required)](https://play.phalanxduel.com)
- [Interactive Combat Lab / Battle Calculator]({{ '/tools/battle-calculator/' | absolute_url }})
- [Video Tutorials & Masterclass Series (33 Episodes + Full Transcripts)]({{ '/learn/tutorials/' | absolute_url }})
- [Official YouTube Playlist (@just3ws-mike)](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list={{ site.data.tutorials.playlist_id }})
